what: One hub repository named main.hub routes agents to the public repositories of the programme
why: agents entering any single repository could not tell where the other kinds of question are answered
alternatives: keep only the prose ecosystem map in glosa

what: Pin by lockfile (commit + blob per referenced file), not by git submodules
why: an agent needs a few files per repository; submodules force whole clones and detached heads; commit + blob anchoring is already the convention in the equation registry's provenance manifests

what: An edge is admitted only with a literal evidence text in a pinned public file; repositories without one are class catalog
why: the hub must claim nothing of its own; a relation nobody can re-verify is an assertion
alternatives: admit only repositories with edges and omit the rest

what: Public repositories only; non-public work is neither named nor masked
why: a public hub describes only what the public repositories state about themselves
alternatives: private hub with the full graph

what: Four routing facts were scattered over three places (equation source policy, ontology canon agent file, prose ecosystem map); the hub quotes them instead of restating them

First independent pre-publication review: NOT READY. Several edges passed the checker on a bare repository name that merely co-occurred; the health route showed no gate; role strings were described as 'no claim'
outcome: the checker accepted evidence that did not state the relation

what: Evidence text must occur exactly once in the pinned file, be at least 12 characters and not be a bare repository name; edges were retyped to the relation their source sentence actually states; one self-asserted edge (hub lineage) was removed
why: a substring test cannot tell a statement from a co-occurrence; uniqueness and phrase length make the quoted sentence the evidence
alternatives: keep loose matches and rely on review alone
line-number anchors (break on any edit upstream)

what: A relation that is only the hub's own opinion is not an edge
becomes_rule: An edge is admitted only with evidence

what: Second independent review: NOT READY. One retyped edge stated the opposite of its source sentence, one edge quoted a concept-lineage aside as a foundation statement, the equation route told agents to run a CLI that fails on a clean clone without a build step, and graph files could steer build and materialize outside the repository
outcome: evidence uniqueness alone does not make a sentence state the relation; pull-request data reached git and the file system unvalidated

what: Owner and host are an allow-list in code; ids and every path are validated in load() before any command; build refuses to write outside the repository; the weak edge was dropped rather than retyped to fit
why: the graph files are the attack surface of a public repository that other agents will run
alternatives: trust reviewers to catch hostile pull requests

what: Proceed to publish after the open items were listed (licence, author address, stale pins, upstream housekeeping)
why: the hub states only what the target repositories already publish; a re-lock follows any upstream change

what: Licence: MIT for code, CC BY 4.0 for graph data and documentation; author address kept identical to the author's other public repositories
why: an all-rights-reserved hub contradicts a README that invites others to run the scripts; the address is already public on the target repositories

what: Third independent review (three reviewers): one edge typed as consuming an artefact the target does not contain; a licence status stated wrongly; safety wording that invited delaying the emergency screen; build could be steered through a symbolic link into a git hook; a pin was never required to be on the default branch; unvalidated lock fields were rendered into agent-facing cards
outcome: reproduced on scratch copies; all fixed and each fix negative-tested

what: A pin must be an ancestor of the public default branch; symbolic links and unexpected executable bits fail the check; every lock field is validated with full-string matching; third-party actions are pinned by commit
why: agents fetch what the hub links, so the lock file is a supply-chain surface

what: Final gate: build deleted files outside the repository through a symlinked nodes directory before its own symlink refusal ran; workspace mode accepted a non-default branch
outcome: reproduced on a copy; every command now refuses to run on a tree that contains a symbolic link, the stale-card delete is confined to nodes/, and both modes require the default branch; exploit re-run: victim file survives
